Name: Expanded Storage
Author: LeFauxMatt
TagLine: Expanded Storage allows Content Pack Creators to add more custom storage options to the game.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png)
This mod allows Content Pack Creators to add custom storage to the game. Expand Requirements to see Content Packs supported by this mod.

![](https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png)
Expanded Storage is safe to add/remove at any time. Custom chests added by Expanded Storage will revert to vanilla chests if Expanded Storage is removed from your game. It should work with any other mod.

![](https://i.imgur.com/7FhH4Ge.png)
Expanded Storage chests are loaded using [Content Patcher](https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/ExpandedStorage/blob/main/docs/content-patcher.md) and can be customized with [Better Chests](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791).
Check out the latest version of [6480's Storage Variety](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807) for an example which uses most of Expanded Storage's features.

Feel free to visit me on my [Discord server](https://lxnq.to/discord) for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You can also request help from me on the Stardew Valley discord in [#modded-tech-support](https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/1272025932932055121)  (ping me @LeFauxMatt).
